neighbours.label: the 'This is / This can be' slot right after a software tool or feature has been described, where 'useful/handy' is the expected continuation; the same frame after an everyday mishap stays low
fire: The editor can split the screen in two. This can be handy for comparing files.
The command prints every open socket. This is great when tracking down leaks.
You can pin a tab so it never closes. This could be nice for long sessions.
The app can sync notes across devices. This can be convenient on the road.
Use the dry-run flag to preview changes. This is a good way to avoid mistakes.
The plugin highlights trailing spaces. This can come in handy during reviews.
The debugger can pause on any exception. This is especially nice for async code.
The script backs up the database nightly. This could save you hours someday.
quiet: The kids fought over the last cookie. This can be tiring for any parent.
The roof leaked during the night. This is common after a heavy storm.
He forgot his umbrella again. This could be a problem in April.
The bus was forty minutes late. This can be stressful on a cold morning.
Her cat knocked over a vase. This is the third time this month.
The neighbours play loud music. This can be annoying late at night.
The river flooded the low fields. This is normal in early spring.
My uncle caught the flu last week. This could last a few more days.

predictions: fire 0.5-1.2 on ' be'/' is' after a tool description; mishap or hazard contexts below 0.2
short: 'This can be' after a tool feature (predicts useful)
notes: Card: ' is' x9, ' be' x6 of top 32 ('This could be really useful', 'This can be particularly useful'); suppresses ' useful' on the + side. Probe: offline export 'This can be' 1.219, open-ports 'This is useful' 0.760, 'This is the default' 0.742 (the setup alone fires, not the word useful), skip-tests 0.786; slipped on ice 0.116, storm 0.108. Near misses keep 'This can be/This is' but after a non-tool event.
